capabilities: Run article presets (summarize, translate, rewrite, key points, title + tags) on the current note or selection and copy, insert, append, or apply results
Chat with the note or selection attached in multi-tab conversations with streamed replies and resumable history
Run a chosen preset over every note in a folder, writing results into each note
Apply JSON Schema preset output to note frontmatter, merging title and tags
Configure the agy executable path, model, reply language, tool access, and custom instructions
disambiguation: Not the Antigravity CLI itself; it is an Obsidian bridge that drives the already-installed and signed-in agy executable.
extras: Desktop only (the plugin spawns a local process); only Windows 10 was manually tested, macOS and Linux use the same protocol but are unverified. Installable via BRAT while pending directory acceptance.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI text processing, and most AI plugins require an API key stored in the vault instead of reusing an existing signed-in CLI.

requires.name: Antigravity CLI (agy), installed and signed in
Google Antigravity account via the CLI's own sign-in

summary: AI assistant that runs Gemini models through the locally installed Antigravity CLI to summarize, translate, rewrite, and chat about notes, with batch folder runs.
